notes: Alaska has no state individual income tax, so self-employment income is taxed only federally.
Alaska also has no statewide sales tax; some boroughs and cities levy local sales taxes, which do not affect income tax.

seDeduction.note: Not applicable: Alaska has no individual income tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: Not applicable: Alaska has no individual income tax.

retirementContributions.note: Not applicable: Alaska has no individual income tax.

qbi.note: Not applicable: Alaska has no individual income tax.

localIncomeTax.note: No Alaska borough or city levies a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Not applicable: no state individual income tax.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $250 Articles of Organization for a domestic LLC (Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $100 biennial report for a domestic LLC, due January 2 every two years ($137.50 with late fee after February 1).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for LLCs. Separately, nearly every business operating in Alaska needs a state business license: $50 per year (may be bought for one or two years).
